Definition: to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive)
BiblicalUsage: Mush means to depart, to withdraw, to move away — the pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night departed not from before the people, this book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, and the mountains shall depart but My kindness shall not depart from thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word draws the line between what leaves and what stays: pillars and mountains depart, and His kindness does not.
RelatedTopics: Faithfulness of God; Presence of God; Covenant
